'''Darth Mud Freezing with Bounty Hunters''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Mud]]
* '''Published:''' 11 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / Cloud City Occupation|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed CCT Mud DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck freezes a character, then transports that character to the Audience Chamber.

== Strategy ==

On your first turn, Deploy Lando to Prison from reserve deck. Use one force to search for one of 2 Ugnaughts, Ugloste, Carbon-Freezing, or Prepare The Chamber. Deploy Cloud City: East Platform and We're The Bait (if possible). Deploy other characters to Carbon Camber.

Each turn, use one force to search for one of 2 Ugnaughts, Ugloste, Carbon-Freezing, or Prepare The Chamber and search for Tatooine locations. Deploy characters to block the opponents force drains and battle. When you deploy Jabba’s Palace: Audience Chamber, and deploy Boelo (from reserve deck) and another character there.

Once you have deployed 2 Ugnaughts, Ugloste, and Carbon-Freezing, and have Prepare The Chamber in hand, move Lando over. Freeze (if destiny +11 >10). The opponent loses 8 force. Deploy Despair and a vehicle (if possible). Deploy backup if possible. Move two sites (one without vehicle).

Next Turn: Move Lando to Chamber, flip ojective.

The rest of the game is just battling, retrieving, and draining. Your aliens are immune to attrition <4, and you retrieve one force during your control phase. The only card that requires luck is a vehicle, which I have five of in my deck.

Card Choices:

All Wrapped Up: Lets you capture characters, stopping them from being deplyed again.

Boelo: Cancels one battle destiny at Audience Chamber.

Weapon Levitation: Allows many of your characters to steal a weapon.

Limited Resources: Causes the opponent to lose 4 force, save these for end game when hands are low.

Dark Jedi Lightsaber: Not enough copies of each main with a matching saber, so these are included.

Binders: Allows bounty hunters to have more captives.
